a1_1_obligations.retry_and_effect_rule: Retry within one attempt is admissible only before effects or with direct proof the operation is effect-free. a1_1_obligations.knowledge_rule: Agents propose only. Apply requires evaluator admission, exact gate, current base fingerprint and fence, one sealed CAS receipt, byte-identical exact replay, no partial write, and sealed retention/deletion/minimization evidence.
a1_1_obligations.j0_j7_rule: S0 records the Taskplane 2.19.0 J0 baseline; every S1-S6 exit reruns J0. J7 continues to carry actual coverage, decomposition, Plan, seam-manifest, Build, and conformance outputs with each severance independently reported.

j0_regression_policy.baseline: S0 proves the J0 invariant through the installed Taskplane 2.19.0 public lifecycle/dispatch/collection path before product slices.
j0_regression_policy.invariant: A fresh clone and empty home take one small real requirement to the same declared terminal outcome without operator repair, fabricated output, skipped shared boundary, degraded evidence, or missing telemetry seal.
j0_regression_policy.incumbent_shared_boundary: public lifecycle -> RunStore pickup/recovery -> delivery/observation dispatch and collection -> stage handoff -> evaluator/finalization
j0_regression_policy.runtime_shared_boundary: phase-definition/v1 -> agent-runtime/v1 -> incumbent ports -> closed stage-handoff/v2 -> evaluator/finalization
j0_regression_policy.mode_equivalence: Same input, requirement/candidate, outcome, producer lineage, real-host evidence class, gates, no-intervention rule, telemetry seal, and visible refusal behavior.
j0_regression_policy.severance_scope: Agent-runtime removal/bypass cases execute only for S3-S6. S0-S2 sever the corresponding incumbent shared boundary and must fail the same user-visible invariant rather than skip.
j0_regression_policy.rule: Each exit requires a fresh exact-candidate real J0 receipt in its declared implementation mode; skip, xfail, degraded host, fixture substitution, operator repair, or mode-specific boundary severance blocks.

journeys.actual_output_rule: Mode-conditional actual producer rule: S0-S2 consume actual outputs through the incumbent Taskplane 2.19.0 public lifecycle/RunStore/delivery-observation dispatch-and-collection/stage-handoff/evaluator-finalization boundary; S3-S6 consume actual outputs through phase-definition/v1 plus agent-runtime/v1 and its incumbent ports. No fixture, predecessor runtime, cross-mode substitution, or missing producer output may satisfy either mode.
journeys.incumbent_shared_boundary: Installed Taskplane 2.19.0 public lifecycle -> RunStore pickup/recovery -> delivery-port/producer-observation dispatch and collection -> stage handoff -> evaluator/finalization path.
journeys.runtime_shared_boundary: phase-definition/v1 -> agent-runtime/v1 -> incumbent RunStore/delivery/observation/review ports -> closed stage-handoff/v2 -> evaluator/finalization path.
journeys.mode_equivalence: Both modes bind the same fresh user input, requirement/candidate, declared outcome, actual producer lineage, real-supported-host evidence class, attributable gate set, no-intervention rule, telemetry seal, and public refusal behavior.
journeys.severance_scope: agent-runtime removal or bypass is a valid negative only for S3-S6. S0-S2 instead remove or bypass one corresponding incumbent lifecycle/dispatch/collection component and require the same visible journey failure rather than a skip.
journeys.baseline: S0 records J0 green on the installed Taskplane 2.19.0 baseline before any product slice lands.
journeys.blocking_rule: Any operator repair, removed/bypassed shared mechanism component, nonconforming phase output, degraded host, or missing telemetry seal prevents completion.
journeys.entry: clean supported installation plus attributable initial and consolidated implementation authorization
journeys.operator_intervention: No manual filesystem edits, receipt injection, CLI repair, relaunch, state mutation, or evidence fabrication after authorization. Explicit human policy gates are supplied as bound input receipts and are not operator repair.
journeys.slice_regression_gate: Every S1-S6 exit requires a fresh candidate-bound J0 result; skip, xfail, operator repair, degraded host, fixture substitution, or a removed shared component blocks the slice.

knowledge_governance.admission: The declared domain validator validates the proposal; only the phase's canonical gate may admit it. The incumbent knowledge-store owner appends admitted updates and emits the new fingerprint.
knowledge_governance.forbidden: In-run writes, self-modification, mutable shared memory, cross-scope reads, and silent update drops are forbidden. A rejected update becomes a finding while otherwise conforming phase outputs remain independently admissible.
knowledge_governance.input: Knowledge is read-only in-run and enters only as a scoped content-addressed artifact in the sealed package. Identical inputs include the exact knowledge fingerprint; a changed fingerprint is a changed operation input.

lens_refresh.rule: Existing result files and fingerprints are preserved as historical input but cannot evidence the merged content. Fresh lens results must be produced against the provisional merged content fingerprint before final lens synthesis or Design approval.
lens_refresh.unaffected_dispositions: stand unless a required rerun raises a new positive signal

native_host_contract.contingency_exit: A current exact host/version capability receipt plus one fresh real canary proves host-owned start identity, terminal identity, collected output, duplicate convergence, and missing-event refusal through the production adapter.
native_host_contract.current_capability_status: S0 must prove the complete real envelope through stable host-owned events or current Taskplane-owned nonce hook receipts. If neither exists, degraded_observation is an explicit blocker and human rescope option, never implicit evidence.

allowed_uses: non-real criterion evidence explicitly labeled simulated or degraded

native_host_contract.dq02_resolution: S0 first exercises the existing Codex producer-observation path. If it exposes stable host-owned identities, no transport change is needed. Otherwise, when Taskplane hooks execute, the shared runtime generates a per-attempt nonce, binds it into the sealed package/environment, and Taskplane SessionStart/PreToolUse/Stop hooks emit sealed receipts carrying that nonce; observation uses those receipts rather than unstable transcript or role-marker parsing. This changes no host and creates no lifecycle or storage owner. If hooks are unavailable, emit degraded_observation with exact gaps and present explicit human Product rescope or capability repair; degraded/simulated evidence cannot satisfy J0, J1, J6, final sign-off, or publication under the current requirement.
native_host_contract.evidence_modes: real_supported_host is satisfied only by current stable host-owned events or Taskplane-owned nonce hook receipts through the production adapter. simulated/degraded remains diagnostic only and cannot satisfy J0, J1, J6, sign-off, or publication under the current requirement.

native_host_contract.replay: Same operation and request fingerprint is idempotent and returns or reconciles the prior observation; changed input under an operation is a permanent refusal.
native_host_contract.selected_host: local Codex native host with installed Taskplane 2.19.0

taskplane_nonce_fallback.degraded_rule: degraded_observation remains diagnostic only and blocks J0, J1, J6, final sign-off, and publication unless a human explicitly changes Product scope in a new requirement/Design binding; it never converts simulation to real evidence.
taskplane_nonce_fallback.ownership: Nonce generation and receipt sealing are Taskplane-owned runtime/telemetry capabilities; the host is unchanged. No transcript parsing, role-marker inference, synthetic terminal, or copied authority is allowed.
preference_order: Use stable host-owned events through the incumbent adapter when the S0 canary proves the complete envelope.

If stable host identity is absent but Taskplane hooks execute, generate a per-attempt cryptographic nonce, bind it into the sealed package/environment, and observe Taskplane SessionStart, PreToolUse, and Stop receipts carrying that nonce.
If hooks cannot execute, emit degraded_observation and stop native-dependent journeys for explicit human rescope or capability repair.
taskplane_nonce_fallback.success: J1 capability is real-supported-host evidence when either stable host events or current Taskplane nonce hook receipts prove start, terminal, collection, duplicate convergence, and missing-event refusal.

native_host_contract.unknown_fields: Within v1, consumers ignore only unknown optional non-authority fields; they reject unknown required or authority-affecting fields, unknown enums, and unknown schema majors.

negative_selector_policy.masking_rule: One passing or failing branch cannot satisfy, skip, xfail, or hide another branch. Missing case receipts make the parent proof incomplete.
negative_selector_policy.parameterization: Every negative/severed selector with more than one case must use explicit pytest parameter IDs and emit a separate case receipt. The aggregate selector passes only when every declared case ID is collected, executed, and independently reported; execution may not short-circuit after the first failure.

phase_agent_model.agent_rule: Each phase agent is stateless, receives exactly one sealed package, applies its phase skill and working lenses, and emits candidate artifacts conforming to its declared produces set.
phase_agent_model.authority_field_rule: evaluation_lenses, gate, predecessors, successors, edge_conditions, entry, and terminal are orchestrator-owned definition fields. Agent-produced copies are ignored and recorded as a refusal finding; singular successor is invalid; the evaluated agent's working-lens configuration is absent from the evaluator package.
phase_agent_model.extension_rule: Adding a phase changes only settings/agents/<name>.*, skills/<name>/SKILL.md, and its tests. The sole optional exception is a registered domain validator declared by id; shared runtime, dispatch, pickup, storage, hook, and lifecycle edits make the extension nonconforming.
phase_agent_model.lifecycle_boundary: No phase agent receives a lifecycle API or may approve, advance, dispatch, persist, mutate definitions, change evaluation lenses, or read outside the sealed package. The runtime refuses lifecycle_api_attempt before the effect.
phase_agent_model.orchestrator_rule: The orchestrator is the sole continuation owner: it loads ordered definitions, assembles packages, dispatches through the shared runtime, collects and validates outputs, dispatches the evaluator with its own canonical lens set, applies gates, and decides progression from typed receipts.

phase_definition_contract.authority_rule: Only orchestrator-loaded definitions may supply evaluation_lenses, gate, predecessors, successors, edge_conditions, entry, and terminal; agent-produced copies are ignored for authority and emitted as refusal findings. Singular successor is invalid.
phase_definition_contract.binding_rule: Definition-set, phase-definition, skill-content, validator identities/inventory, consumed/produced artifact schema versions, and capability-set fingerprints bind dispatch, result, evaluation, gate, handoff, and continuation.
phase_definition_contract.loading: The orchestrator loads and validates an ordered versioned set and sequences from definitions; loop.py hardcodes no phase list.
phase_definition_contract.unknown_fields: Reject unknown required fields. Unknown optional non-authority fields follow v1 compatibility policy.

summary: Provisional A1.1 Design-owned behavioral proof plan: 21 criteria, eight actual-producer journeys, per-slice J0 regression, sole bound phase-definition registry/DAG, strict thin runtime boundary, closed results, proposal/apply knowledge CAS and sealing, Taskplane nonce plus evaluator independence, effect-free or attempt-fenced retry with reconciliation, independent negative cases, fixture-bypass detection, and sealed terminal telemetry.
